header.name: Topics on Multivariate Analysis
header.description: The univariate data analysis is common. However, the same methodologies can not be applied to study the multivariate data. In this course, we will study the methodologies to study and analyze the multivariate data. The Multivariate Normal distribution will be discussed in detail. The hypothesis testing of multivariate data will also be discussed. The multiple linear regression model will be covered. The methodologies will be applied to real-life data sets.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to understand the importance of multivariate data analysis and study multivariate normal distribution in detail.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will learn how to perform hypothesis testing for multivariate data.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to build and analyze statistical models used for multivariate data.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to build codes in R (or equivalent) to study the multivariate data and make interpretations.

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to analyze the real-life multivariate data sets.

lecture_topics: Revision of methodologies in univariate data analysis
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Tut I : On revision and MVN

lecture_topics: Multivariate Normal distribution(MVN) : density, properties, geometry, mle
sampling distribution of mean and sample variance
Testing of a mean vector : Hotelling's T^2, LRT
Comparisons of various means: paired, two populations
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Tut V : MANOVA, various mean comparisons

lecture_topics: Multiple Linear Regression Model : estimation, hypothesis testing, inferences, model checking and other aspects
